items.teaser: U.S. stocks jumped, even as Nvidia’s shares sank after the company’s board launched an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang.

items.teaser: Karen Karniol-Tambour’s appointment marks the next step in Prime Minister Mark Carney’s effort to jump start the construction of so-called national projects, and help promising domestic startups expand.

items.title: Honda to Invest $3 Billion in New Ohio Plant to Boost Hybrid Vehicle Production
items.teaser: The facility, which is expected to begin production in 2029, would be capable of building 240,000 vehicles a year, bringing the company’s total U.S. auto production capacity to about 1.3 million annually.

Private Credit Lenders Eye $1.3 Billion Loan for Fullscript
items.teaser: A group of private credit lenders is in talks to provide a $1.3 billion loan to finance L Catterton’s acquisition of healthcare platform Fullscript, after the deal was unable to drum up enough interest in the leveraged loan market.

items.title: Australia Watchdog Probes Bathla as Private Credit Flaws Persist
items.teaser: Australia’s corporate regulator has opened an investigation into insolvent Sydney developer Bathla Group as its latest surveillance showed that poor practices persist in the country’s A$250 billion ($172 billion) private credit industry.

items.title: Ecopetrol Is Selling $2 Billion in Bonds in Global Markets
items.teaser: Ecopetrol SA is offering dollar bonds for the first time in more than two years, the second Colombian company to tap global markets this month as it refinances debt used to fund its expansion in Brazil.

items.title: Most Treasuries Fall as Investors Regain Risk Appetite
items.teaser: Most Treasuries fell as investor appetite for riskier assets including stocks and corporate bonds recovered, damping the appeal of US government bonds as a hedge.

items.title: US Natural Gas Surges Most in Six Weeks, Triggers Short Squeeze
items.teaser: US natural gas futures jumped by as much as 8.3%, the most since September, after forecasts for cooler weather along the Atlantic seaboard gave prices an upward push and forced hedge funds to unwind bearish bets.

items.title: Anthropic IPO’s Moment of Truth Nears as Waiting Period Ends
items.teaser: Anthropic PBC can begin formally marketing its much-anticipated IPO as early as Tuesday, enabling it to make the case to investors that now is the right time to go public despite last week’s swoon in artificial intelligence-related stocks.
